snippet.title: Sonic Racing - Cross the Worlds - (Opening ver.) | Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
snippet.description:
Sonic Racing - Cross the Worlds - (Opening ver.)
Performed by James Bourne of Busted
Music by Takahiro Kai
Lyrics by James Bourne
Rap Lyrics by Chez & Yuki Kanesaka
Music Arranged by Masashi Tsubakimoto & Yoshiya Ikeda

Sound Produced by Jun Senoue

Listen to Sonic Racing - Cross the Worlds - (Opening ver.) on your favorite streaming platform: https://lnk.to/crosstheworldsop
